An ingredient laid by adult chickens every five to ten active minutes.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Tags | `egg`, `raw_egg` |

## How to obtain

Pick up eggs near adult [Chickens](Chickens.md).

## Using it

Cook into Cooked Egg in either Cooker. Raw eggs cannot be eaten or hatched.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
